title: Pillar Candles 3-Pack – LED Candles with Remote and Timer
seo_title: Pillar Candles 3-Pack – LED Candles with Remote
seo_description: 3 LED pillar candles in gray glass, 10/12.5/15 cm tall, 7.8 cm diameter. Remote control and timer 2/4/6/8 h. Batteries not included.
descriptionHtml:
The candles stay unlit because nobody can be bothered to light them by hand

Three real pillar candles of different heights have to be lit one by one and then blown out again before everyone goes to bed. If you forget one lit when you fall asleep, it's no longer a cozy evening, it's a worry. So often the easiest answer is that the candles never get lit at all.

Three heights, one press on the remote

The set has three LED pillar candles in gray glass – 10, 12.5 and 15 cm tall, all 7.8 cm in diameter – that turn on and off with the included remote control, with a timer of 2, 4, 6 or 8 hours if you want them to switch off by themselves.

Features

  • 3 pillar candles of different heights – 10, 12.5 and 15 cm in gray glass, lit with the same remote control.
  • Light all three without getting up – the remote control switches the candles on and off from a distance.
  • Set the time and forget them – the timer of 2, 4, 6 or 8 hours switches the candles off automatically.
  • Same diameter, three heights – 7.8 cm in diameter makes all three look like a series, not three different candles.
  • Uses your own batteries – each candle runs on 3 AA batteries, which are not included in the package.

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.

Change your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
